paragraphs.text: Alicorn is an acorn creature type representing a species of equines that have the features of both Pegasi and Unicorns —wings and a horn. It is a crossover type from the My Little Pony franchise.

The type was introduced to Magic: The Gathering with the 2019 Ponies: The Galloping promotional charity set. Princess Twilight Sparkle in that box set is a lord for alicorns, unicorns , horses , pegasuses and ponies .
A hypothetical card depicting a similar creature within Magic' s own setting would likely be a Pegasus Unicorn, rather than an Alicorn.
